title: Disable Filesystem Kernel Module
description: Disable a filesystem kernel module on a managed host by unloading it if loaded and preventing future loads via modprobe.d blacklist and install /bin/false.

playbook_input.description: Parameters the caller provides before execution

parameters.name: target_server
parameters.description: The managed host to SSH into and disable the module on.

parameters.name: filesystem_module
parameters.description: Name of the filesystem kernel module to disable (e.g. gfs2).

fields.name: module_name
fields.description: The name of the filesystem module that was targeted.

fields.name: exists
fields.description: Whether the kernel module directory was found on the system.

fields.name: loaded
fields.description: Whether the module was loaded before remediation.

fields.name: unload_attempted
fields.description: True if an unload was attempted (module was loaded).

fields.name: unload_successful
fields.description: True if the unload command succeeded; null if not attempted.

fields.name: warning
fields.description: Warning message if unload failed, otherwise empty or null.

fields.name: config_created
fields.description: True if one or more modprobe.d configuration lines were added.

steps.name: Gather filesystem module directory listing
steps.function: Find directories under /lib/modules/ matching the filesystem module path to determine if the module exists on the system.

steps.name: Determine if module exists
steps.function: Set _module_exists to true if the find command returned at least one directory.

steps.name: Does the module exist on this system?
steps.function: Branch based on whether the kernel module directory was found.
steps.condition: The filesystem module directory was found (module exists).

steps.name: Compute underscore module name and config path
steps.function: Derive underscore variant of module name for modprobe commands and the full path to the .conf file.

computations._modname_underscore: Replace hyphens with underscores in filesystem_module.

steps.name: Check if kernel module is loaded
steps.function: Run lsmod and grep for the module (using its underscore name) to determine if it is currently loaded.

steps.name: Set loaded boolean
steps.function: Convert the lsmod grep exit code to a boolean loaded flag.

steps.name: Is the kernel module currently loaded?
steps.function: Branch on whether the module is loaded.
steps.condition: The lsmod output indicates the module is loaded.

steps.name: Record module not loaded state
steps.function: Set unload variables to indicate no unload was attempted because the module was not loaded.

steps.name: Attempt to unload the module
steps.function: Try to remove the kernel module using modprobe -r and rmmod.

steps.name: Record unload failure warning
steps.function: Set unload failure status and warning message when the unload command fails.

computations._unload_warning: WARNING: Could not unload module (possibly in use). Blacklisting still applied.

steps.name: Record successful unload variables
steps.function: Set unload success variables when the module was successfully removed.

steps.name: Check modprobe configuration for blacklist/install
steps.function: Run modprobe --showconfig and grep for existing blacklist and install entries for the module (using underscore name).

steps.name: Parse modprobe config presence
steps.function: Determine whether the blacklist line and install /bin/false line already exist.

computations._blacklist_present: True if _showconfig_raw.stdout contains a line matching 'blacklist <_modname_underscore>' exactly.
computations._install_present: True if contains a line matching 'install <_modname_underscore> /bin/false'.

steps.name: Are both blacklist and install /bin/false present?
steps.function: Branch on whether the required configuration already exists.
steps.condition: Both the blacklist entry and the install /bin/false entry exist in modprobe configuration.

steps.name: Ensure blacklist line in config
steps.function: Create or update the modprobe.d conf file to include the blacklist line for the module using the lineinfile module.

steps.name: Ensure install /bin/false line in config
steps.function: Ensure the install /bin/false line is present in the modprobe.d conf file.

steps.name: Prepare final status summary
steps.function: Aggregate all collected facts into a final status, including whether configuration was newly created.

computations._config_created: True if either the blacklist or install entry was missing (i.e., not both present), false otherwise.
computations._status: Set to 'not_found' if _module_exists is false, 'already_configured' if both _blacklist_present and _install_present are true, otherwise 'configured'.

steps.name: Set module not found status
steps.function: Set output variables indicating the module was not found on the system.

steps.name: Emit result block
steps.function: Print the required output format <result> block on success.

steps.name: Emit error and fail
steps.function: Reached via the playbook's rescue block on any task failure. Prints the required error output and fails the play.

phases.name: Pre-checks
phases.description: Gather existence and loading status of the filesystem kernel module.

phases.name: Module unload
phases.description: Compute module name variants, check loaded state, and attempt to unload if necessary.

phases.name: Modprobe configuration
phases.description: Inspect and enforce blacklist and install /bin/false entries in /etc/modprobe.d.

phases.name: Reporting
phases.description: Assemble final status and emit the structured result to the caller.

phases.name: Error handling
phases.description: Reached when any step fails; records failure and halts execution.
